name: High-End GP Clinic (premium private GP)
tags: premium, private billing, boutique hotel feel, fluted timber, arched portal, 6 consults, procedure room, Rev A
description:
Premium private-billing general practice that feels like a boutique hotel or wellness retreat, not a bulk-billing clinic. Designed for an assumed c. 300 m² tenancy (c. 20 x 15 m, one glazed shopfront, rear service access). Designed to the intent of the RACGP Standards for general practices 5th ed.

KEY DESIGN MOVES
- Concierge curved reception with direct sight to the entry, lounge, quiet waiting and the clinical portal.
- Quiet / infectious waiting by the door: own glazed room, separate exhaust [TBC]; nearest consult is Consult 1 (isolation-capable).
- Arched portal splits the public lounge from the clinical zone.
- Public zone along the shopfront: lounge, concierge, refreshment point, quiet / infectious waiting and accessible WC.
- Six generous consults (14.4–14.7 m²), clinician desk at the door side for a clear exit, couch behind a curtain, hand basin in every consult.
- Treatment / nurse suite + procedure room interconnect; dirty utility next door (clean-to-dirty flow). Discreet pathology off the clinical portal.
- Private exit / discharge route via the rear corridor door (second exit, subject to certifier) [TBC].
- Staff lounge, practice manager office and stores off a back-of-house spine, away from patients.
- Corridors: 1600 mm clear clinical corridor (E-W) and a 1600 mm back-of-house spine (N-S) to the rear exit.
- Partitions to slab, acoustic insulated, Rw 45 min / Rw 50 target to consults.
finishes: Fluted timber veneer joinery (oak or American walnut [TBC]) to the concierge desk, back counter, refreshment point and consult storage walls; solid-surface (acrylic) tops; arched forms; warm layered light (cove + pendants 3000–3500K [TBC]); upholstered acoustic panels; art and planting; timber-look engineered floor or carpet tile in public areas, sheet vinyl in clinical rooms [TBC]; subtle DR Fitout violet accents at the portal, in pinstripes and handles.
